summary: Persist rejected candidate lessons in a deterministic versioned snapshot and make the optimizer surface exact rejections and same-ID content conflicts.
implementation: NegativeKnowledge.save writes a schema-versioned canonical JSON payload with SHA-256 integrity; create mode prevents replacing an existing snapshot.
NegativeKnowledge.load validates envelope, version, content hash, lesson shape, and unique lesson IDs before exposing a fresh store.
Rejected lesson mappings are detached on storage and when read. Reusing an ID with changed content returns CONFLICT and preserves the original lesson.

An optimizer run supplied with a store skips exact matching lessons before candidate policy and tournament creation, reports machine-readable skip reasons, and continues other candidates. Changed same-ID content returns an explicit top-level CONFLICT.
The optimizer reuse test saves the rejected lesson, loads it into a fresh NegativeKnowledge instance, and verifies the second run skips it. Snapshot tests also reject mismatched schema identity.
Default optimizer behavior and holdout promotion gates remain unchanged; no real-world accuracy claim is made.
